title: Expansive Border
description: Level up your adventure — literally! With this plugin, your world border expands every time you gain a level or earn an advancement.
body:
🌍 Expanding World Border Plugin ✨

Level up your adventure — literally! With this plugin, your world border expands every time you gain a level or earn an advancement. 🌱🎖️

⚙️ How It Works

🧭 Start small: Begin your journey in a limited area

🆙 Level up: Each XP level you gain pushes the border outward

🏅 Earn advancements: Major milestones trigger even bigger expansions

🌎 Grow your world: Explore new lands as you progress — your success shapes the size of your world!

Perfect for survival servers or progression-based worlds where exploration feels earned and rewarding. 🌟
